name: Orbeon Forms Community Edition Self-Hosted
free_limit: LGPL-2.1 open-source Community Edition for self-hosted form building and form runtime; no vendor-managed form or response quota for your own installation.
watch_out: Requires self-managed Java servlet container, database, storage, updates and backups. Community Edition is self-supported; Professional Edition subscriptions, commercial support and some advanced features cost extra. Free Docker trial is for PE, not an ongoing hosted free tier. LGPL and third-party license obligations apply.
